branches.meaning: s8(actor+2001) counts down; zero clears actor+2000
s16(actor+1272) counts down; zero clears actor+1268
s16(actor+1274) counts down; zero clears actor+1270
a nonzero actor+460 vector skips the state write
the normalized actor+460 Y reaches the ground constant
u8(actor+628) bit 1 gates the pair pass
a global counter gates the pair pass
f32 slot comparison chooses the pair order
a zero global[1652+index*4] entry takes the C0F8 path

notes: Each branch records the nearest flag-setting compare/mask in the eight instructions before it.

`operand`/`operands` name the last load, immediate or mask that fed the tested register, following a sign extension or move. For float compares it is the last load into the compared register, not the whole expression.
A 'sense' of true branches when the condition holds; false is the inverse test (for example beq vs bne).
Named gates are the broad-phase and early geometry branches whose field loads are unambiguous; other handler semantics remain open.
